records.claim: A few studies have looked at child development from 16 months to 7 years of age and found no differences between children exposed to fluoxetine during pregnancy and those who were not. Most studies have not found an increased chance of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in children exposed to SSRIs, such as fluoxetine, during pregnancy. Most studies also have not found an increased chance of autism spectrum disorder (ASD) after considering other factors, such as the mother’s illness.
records.source_section: Does taking fluoxetine in pregnancy affect future behavior or learning for the child?
